zh.title: 工业视觉边缘 AI Runtime · 项目演示
zh.description: 工业缺陷检测项目展厅：Qt 工作台、C++ Runtime、有界并发、INT8 量化实验及跨平台功能验证。

hero.heading: 从缺陷检测模型，到可演示、可复现的 C++ 工程。
hero.lead: 将工业表面缺陷检测串成完整链路：桌面交互、配置与模型契约、FP32 / INT8 推理、有界批处理、结果校验，以及 Windows、Linux 与 AArch64 的功能验证。
hero.image_alt: Qt 工作台成功完成六张样例检测，展示原图、检测框、逐图结果和生效参数
hero.caption: Qt 客户端 · 六张样例全部完成 · 原图、检测框与逐图结果联动。

features.title: 让检测可操作
features.body: 单图、批量、协作停止、缩放与结果浏览，形成完整桌面流程。

features.title: 让主链可复用
features.body: CLI 与 Qt 共用配置、模型契约、pipeline、session 和结果协议。

features.title: 让优化可解释
features.body: 用独立 benchmark、profiling 和质量报告说明收益与代价。

features.title: 让移植有证据
features.body: Windows / Linux 实测，AArch64 交叉构建与 QEMU 功能验证。

tour.heading: 一批图片，一条完整的成功流程
tour.lead: 从配置输入到批次完成，再切换图片、放大检查检测框。点击任一步骤停留查看，或播放完整动图。
tour.label: 演示步骤
captions: 01 · 选择 RuntimeConfig 与图片目录，设置并发数量和队列容量。模型参数由同一套 Runtime 校验。
02 · 加载、推理与结果写出在后台执行，工作台保持响应，并显示忙碌状态。
03 · 六张样例全部检测成功，按输入顺序显示目标数量与逐图耗时，结果自动归档。
04 · 选择检测明细，在图像中高亮对应框；放大到原始像素检查局部细节。
05 · 选择划痕样例，原图、标注图和检测明细同步切换，直接读取本次已保存的结果。
06 · 恢复适应窗口，查看完整图片与批次列表，随时打开 JSON 或结果目录。
tour.noscript: 启用 JavaScript 可切换步骤；也可以直接查看动图：

architecture.heading: 界面与命令行，共用一条业务主链
architecture.lead: Qt 是 Runtime 的应用适配层。模型切换、预处理、后处理、批处理调度和结果写出沿用既有工程，实现一次、验证多处。
architecture.stage3_body: 输出解码 · 阈值过滤 · NMS
architecture.stage4_body: JSON · 标注图 · 批次汇总
architecture.note: project_core 保持轻量；Runtime 承接视觉推理依赖；Qt Widgets 仅在独立、可选的应用 target 中启用。

cards.title: 显式的模型契约
cards.body: RuntimeConfig 定义运行参数，ModelArtifactSpec 声明模型、类别及 I/O 语义。FP32 与 INT8 通过配置切换，外部 I/O 均保持 float32。

cards.title: 有上限的并发资源
cards.body: BatchRunner 使用有界队列，每个 worker 独占 pipeline / session。按输入顺序收集结果，损坏单图不会阻断其他任务，停止请求允许在途任务完成。

cards.title: 独立维护的展示层
cards.body: GUI 线程负责控件与交互，后台调用既有 Runtime。表格 Model、图像绘制、QSS 与布局集中在 Qt 模块，调整主题不改变推理协议。

engineering.heading: 性能与质量，一起看数据
engineering.lead: 下列图表由仓库已有实验报告生成。量化对比与并发对比分别保留各自的输入、环境和计时口径，点击数据来源可以回到原始记录。
engineering.sources: 查看原始报告与实验协议

platform.heading: 同一份业务源码，跨平台走通
platform.lead: 运行环境、依赖和工具链通过 CMake、工具链文件与脚本组织。矩阵记录已完成的 Runtime 功能验证；Qt 桌面交付目前验证 Windows x64。

run.heading: 打开演示目录，或从源码复现
launch_steps: 完整解压或复制 yolo-defect-qt/，放在可写目录。
打开 demo/index.html；英文指南为 demo/index.en.html。
双击根目录 run.cmd，载入默认配置与样例。
点击“运行检测”，然后尝试目录批处理与逐图浏览。
run.package_note: 演示包收集 Qt、OpenCV、ORT 运行依赖、模型配置及样例，运行时无需安装开发套件、编译器或 Python。
run.source_body: 准备 MSVC x64、Qt 6 Widgets MSVC 套件、OpenCV 和 ORT C++ SDK，并填写本地配置。
run.build_hint: 仓库根目录；已有本地配置请保留
run.edit_paths: 编辑两份本地配置中的 SDK 路径
run.source_note: package 默认生成 dist/yolo-defect-qt/。使用自行构建的目录，或作者交付的完整演示包。
run.tree_contract: 运行配置 / 模型声明
demo_steps: 单图：运行默认样例，查看生效参数、类别、置信度及检测框。
目录：选择 samples/，开始批处理；完成后展示成功计数与逐图结果。
细节：点选表格行，滚轮缩放、拖动平移；点击检测框联动明细，“适应”恢复全图。
Manifest：选择样例清单，展示稳定的输入顺序和可复现的任务列表。
停止：用较大目录演示协作停止，在途图片完成后收尾，再开始一批任务。
结果：打开逐图 JSON、批次汇总与输出目录，说明结果可以复查与比较。

verify.heading: 演示之后，也能回到可复现的验证
verify.lead: UI、Runtime 与交付包各有清晰入口；可视化展示对应具体实现与验收。
rows: FP32 / U8S8、目录 / manifest 的检测结果与顺序一致；停止重启、关闭收尾、选择与缩放。
独立构建与回归，核心逻辑、配置、模型契约、批处理及结果写出。
独立 CPU session，阶段计时、P50 / P95、吞吐量与 ORT 算子分析。
限制 PATH，检查包内运行依赖、真实检测与 Qt 启动。
verify.note: 单图 benchmark 排除 warmup，batch 吞吐量按成功图片数 / processing wall time 计算。GUI 任务总耗时包含准备与写出；QEMU 记录功能结果，原生 ARM 性能需在实际设备上测量。

maintain.heading: 后续美化界面，展示材料同步更新
maintain.lead: README 与两版网页共用媒体资源。页面由一个结构模板和成对文案生成，图表由证据数据生成，让截图、交互步骤与双语介绍保持一致。
maintain.code_hint: 更新真实 UI 素材与双语页面，检查同步后重新打包
maintain.media_title: 素材、图表和中英文页面如何维护
maintain.media_body: qt_demo_capture.cpp 驱动真实 Qt 控件与推理；qt_demo_media.py 生成 PNG、WebP 和 GIF，需安装 requirements-qt-media.txt 中的 Pillow。精选素材位于 docs/assets/qt/，临时帧保留在构建目录。修改颜色、字体、图标或布局后重新运行 media 即可；若控件名称或流程变化，同时更新捕获脚本。
maintain.translation_body: 页面结构与样式只编辑 docs/demo/page.template.html；中英文文案成对维护在 content.json。render_demo.py 同时生成 index.html 与 index.en.html，--check 检查两种语言的字段、步骤数量和输出是否同步。生成后的 HTML 可直接离线打开，无需服务器。
maintain.evidence_body: 仅在实验报告更新时运行下面两条命令。demo_charts.py 读取已提交报告，生成 evidence.json 与 docs/assets/engineering/ 图表，需安装 requirements-demo-charts.txt 中的 Matplotlib。新实验完成后更新来源再生成；不要手工修改图中的数值，模型大小、延迟与质量评估指标保留各自定义。
maintain.guide_link: 查看完整维护说明与文件分工
maintain.video_title: 可选：录制带鼠标轨迹与讲解的视频
maintain.video_body: 可用 OBS 的窗口捕获录制连续操作，或用 ScreenToGif 录制短 GIF。按本页成功流程操作，保留检测完成和结果切换，裁掉无关桌面。
maintain.video_paths: 将视频保存为 docs/assets/qt/walkthrough.mp4，再在共享模板中添加 video controls 元素，以 workbench.png 作为封面。两版网页一并生成；Pages 和打包入口支持复制 MP4，README 可用封面链接。
maintain.pages_body: 将展示文件和 .github/workflows/qt-demo-pages.yml 提交到仓库默认分支。在仓库 Settings → Pages 将 Source 设为 GitHub Actions，再到 Actions 选择 Qt demo Pages，点击 Run workflow。发布成功后使用工作流给出的 Pages 地址。
maintain.pages_paths: 中文页面地址为 /yolo_defect/demo/，英文为 /yolo_defect/demo/index.en.html。后续更新素材和双语页面后重新执行同一工作流。离线移动时一并保留 demo/ 与 assets/，相对路径即可正常加载。
maintain.pages_link: GitHub Pages 官方工作流说明
maintain.dependencies_title: 运行依赖、模型配置与排查入口
maintain.dependencies_body: 开发环境使用匹配 x64 的 Qt / MSVC / OpenCV / ORT SDK。演示包收集运行依赖，整体移动目录即可。运行 verify.ps1 检查包是否完整；若检测失败，先查看界面错误信息与结果 JSON。
maintain.models_body: 默认模型与样例的获取、可选 INT8 生成、配置相对路径和 I/O 契约在 C++ 技术手册统一维护。更换模型时检查输入形状、类别与输出语义；公开分发时保留随包许可材料。

en.title: Industrial Vision Edge AI Runtime · Project showcase
en.description: An industrial defect inspection showcase: Qt desktop client, C++ Runtime, bounded concurrency, INT8 experiments and cross-platform functional validation.

hero.heading: From a defect detection model to a reproducible C++ system.
hero.lead: A complete industrial inspection workflow: desktop interaction, configuration and model contracts, FP32 / INT8 inference, bounded batch processing, result validation, and functional verification across Windows, Linux and AArch64.
hero.image_alt: Qt workbench after six successful detections, showing original and annotated images, batch results and effective parameters
hero.caption: Qt desktop client · All six samples completed · Linked images, detection boxes and per-image results. The desktop UI is currently in Chinese.

features.title: A usable workflow
features.body: Single images, batches, cooperative stop, zoom and result browsing in one desktop client.

features.title: A reusable core
features.body: CLI and Qt share configuration, model contracts, pipelines, sessions and result formats.

features.title: Explainable optimization
features.body: Standalone benchmarks, profiling and quality reports expose both gains and trade-offs.

features.title: Verified portability
features.body: Windows / Linux runs, plus AArch64 cross-builds and functional execution under QEMU.

tour.heading: One batch. A complete successful workflow.
tour.lead: Configure the input, complete a batch, switch images and inspect detection details. Select a step to examine it, or play the full animation.
tour.label: Demonstration steps
captions: 01 · Select a RuntimeConfig and image directory, then set worker count and queue capacity. The shared Runtime validates the model contract.
02 · Loading, inference and result writing run in the background. The workbench remains responsive and shows a busy state.
03 · All six samples succeed. Results retain input order and show detection counts and per-image timings; outputs are saved automatically.
04 · Select a detection row to highlight its box, then inspect image details at native pixel scale.
05 · Select the scratches sample. Original image, annotation and detection details update together from the saved results.
06 · Restore fit-to-window to see the complete image and batch list, with JSON files and output folders ready to open.
tour.noscript: Enable JavaScript to switch steps, or open the animation directly:

architecture.heading: Two applications. One shared Runtime.
architecture.lead: Qt adapts the existing Runtime for desktop interaction. Model selection, preprocessing, postprocessing, batch scheduling and output writing follow the same implementation across application entry points.
architecture.note: project_core stays lightweight; Runtime owns vision dependencies; Qt Widgets is enabled only in a separate, optional application target.

cards.title: Explicit model contracts
cards.body: RuntimeConfig defines execution parameters; ModelArtifactSpec declares model, classes and I/O semantics. FP32 and INT8 are selected by configuration and retain float32 external I/O.

cards.title: Controlled resource use
cards.body: BatchRunner uses a bounded queue, with one pipeline / session owned by each worker. Results preserve input order. A corrupt image does not interrupt other tasks, and cooperative stop lets in-flight work finish.

cards.title: An independent UI layer
cards.body: The GUI thread owns widgets and interaction; background work calls the existing Runtime. Table models, image rendering, QSS and layout live in the Qt module, so visual changes leave inference contracts intact.

engineering.heading: Measure speed. Keep quality in view.
engineering.lead: These charts are generated from existing repository reports. Quantization and concurrency experiments retain their own inputs, environments and timing definitions. Source links lead back to the recorded evidence.
engineering.sources: View source reports and experiment protocols

platform.heading: The same application logic across platforms.
platform.lead: CMake, toolchain files and scripts organize platform dependencies and build environments. This matrix records completed Runtime checks; Qt desktop delivery is currently validated on Windows x64.

run.heading: Open a demo package, or build from source.
launch_steps: Extract or copy the complete yolo-defect-qt/ directory to a writable location.
Open demo/index.en.html; the Chinese guide is demo/index.html.
Double-click run.cmd at the package root to load the default configuration and sample.
Choose Run detection, then explore directory batches and per-image results.
run.package_note: The package collects Qt, OpenCV and ORT runtime dependencies, model configuration and samples. Running it requires no development SDK, compiler or Python installation.
run.source_body: Prepare MSVC x64, the Qt 6 Widgets MSVC kit, OpenCV and the ORT C++ SDK, then fill in local configuration.
run.build_hint: Repository root; preserve existing local configuration
run.edit_paths: Edit SDK paths in both local configuration files
run.source_note: package writes to dist/yolo-defect-qt/ by default. Use your own build or a complete demo directory supplied by the author.
demo_steps: Single image: run the default sample and inspect effective parameters, classes, confidence and detection boxes.
Directory: select samples/, start a batch and review the completed counts and per-image results.
Details: select a row, zoom with the wheel and drag to pan. Click a box to select its detection; Fit restores the full image.
Manifest: select the sample list to demonstrate stable input order and a reproducible task set.
Stop: use a larger directory, request cooperative stop, let in-flight images finish and start another batch.
Outputs: open per-image JSON, the batch summary and the output directory to inspect and compare results.

verify.heading: From the showcase back to reproducible checks.
verify.lead: UI, Runtime and package verification each have a clear entry point. The presentation connects to concrete implementations and acceptance checks.
rows: FP32 / U8S8 and directory / manifest result and order parity; stopping, restarting, closing, selection and zoom.
Independent builds and regression checks for core logic, configuration, contracts, batches and result writing.
Separate CPU sessions, stage timings, P50 / P95, throughput and ORT operator analysis.
Restricted PATH checks for packaged dependencies, real detection and Qt startup.
verify.note: Single-image benchmarks exclude warmup. Batch throughput is successful images / processing wall time. GUI task duration also includes preparation and writing; QEMU establishes functionality, while native ARM performance requires measurements on actual hardware.

maintain.heading: Refresh the UI. Refresh the showcase with it.
maintain.lead: Both READMEs and both pages share media assets. A common template and paired translations generate the pages; recorded evidence generates the charts, keeping screenshots, tour steps and bilingual explanations aligned.
maintain.code_hint: Refresh UI captures and both pages, check synchronization, then repackage
maintain.media_body: qt_demo_capture.cpp drives real Qt widgets and inference; qt_demo_media.py creates PNG, WebP and GIF assets using Pillow from requirements-qt-media.txt. Selected media lives in docs/assets/qt/, with temporary frames in the build directory. After changes to colors, fonts, icons or layout, run media again. Changes to widget names or workflow also require updating the capture script.
maintain.translation_body: Edit page structure and styling only in docs/demo/page.template.html, with paired Chinese and English copy in content.json. render_demo.py generates index.html and index.en.html together; --check detects mismatched translation fields, step counts and stale output. Generated pages work directly offline without a server.
maintain.evidence_body: Run the following commands only when experiment reports change. demo_charts.py reads committed reports to generate evidence.json and docs/assets/engineering/ charts, using Matplotlib from requirements-demo-charts.txt. Update sources after new experiments and regenerate instead of editing plotted values manually. Preserve model-size, latency and quality-metric definitions.
maintain.guide_link: Full maintenance instructions and file ownership
maintain.video_title: Optional: continuous video with pointer movement and narration
maintain.video_body: Use OBS window capture for continuous operation, or ScreenToGif for a short GIF. Follow the successful workflow shown here, retain the completed detection and image switches, and crop out unrelated desktop content.
maintain.video_paths: Save video as docs/assets/qt/walkthrough.mp4 and add a video controls element to the shared template, using workbench.png as its poster. Regenerate both pages. Pages and packaging support copying MP4; READMEs can link a cover image to the video.
maintain.pages_body: Commit the showcase files and .github/workflows/qt-demo-pages.yml to the default branch. In repository Settings → Pages, set Source to GitHub Actions. Open Actions, select Qt demo Pages and choose Run workflow. Use the Pages URL reported after a successful deployment.
maintain.pages_paths: The Chinese page is at /yolo_defect/demo/ and English at /yolo_defect/demo/index.en.html. After refreshing assets and generated pages, run the same workflow again. For offline use, keep demo/ and assets/ together so their relative links continue to work.
maintain.dependencies_body: Development requires matching x64 Qt / MSVC / OpenCV / ORT SDKs. The demo package collects runtime dependencies; move the whole directory together. Run verify.ps1 to check package completeness. If detection fails, inspect the displayed error and result JSON first.
maintain.models_body: The C++ technical guide is the shared reference for obtaining the default model and samples, generating optional INT8 artifacts, resolving relative configuration paths and validating I/O contracts. Check input shape, class mapping and output semantics when replacing a model, and retain bundled license materials when distributing.

footer.note: A runnable, explainable engineering showcase that can evolve with the project.
